transactionId.description: The transaction id as recorded by the bank.

houseNumber.description: The house number (may contain letters, dashes or other characters). Addresses describe ways to tag a single building with multiple addresses.

houseName.description: The name of a house. This is sometimes used in some countries like England instead of (or in addition to) a house number.

flats.description: The house numbers (range or list) of flats behind a door.

conscriptionNumber.description: This special kind of house number relates to a settlement instead of a street. Conscription numbers were introduced in the Austrio-Hungarian Empire and are still in use in some parts of Europe, sometimes together with street-related house numbers which are also called orientation numbers.

street.description: The name of the respective street.

place.description: This is part of an address which refers to the name of some territorial zone (usually like island or square) instead of a street. Should not be used together with street.

postCode.description: The postal code of the building/area.

city.description: The name of the city as given in postal addresses of the building/area.

country.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 two letter country code in upper case.

full.description: Use this for a full-text, often multi-line address if you find the structured address fields unsuitable for denoting the address of this particular location. Examples: 'Fifth house on the left after the village oak, Smalltown, Smallcountry' or '1200 West Sunset Boulevard Suite 110A'. Beware that these strings can hardly be parsed by software.

suburb.description: If an address exists several times in a city. You have to add the name of the settlement. See Australian definition of suburb.

province.description: The province. For Canada, uppercase two-letter postal abbreviations  (BC, AB, ON, QC, etc.) are used. In Russia a synonym region is widely used.

state.description: The state. For the US, uppercase two-letter postal abbreviations (AK, CA, HI, NY, TX, WY, etc.) are used.

Custom.description: Represents an account identifier in bank-custom format.

legalNames.description: A list of names of primary account holders.

Domestic.description: Represents an account in the regional format.

bic.description: optional BIC number for this account.

Iban.description: Represents an account using IBAN format.

TransferEndpoint.description: Money transfer source or destination account
